input.text: Dies betrifft des Deutschen Vertrags wegen nichts.

_note: 'des Deutschen Vertrags' -- one bare adjective plus the common noun 'Vertrag' ('contract/treaty'), with no trailing ueber/gegen qualifying phrase, is NOT a named instrument (unlike 'des Bürgerlichen Gesetzbuchs', where Gesetzbuch is a specific, unambiguous statute-type word). Vertrag/Abkommen are excluded from the 'one bare adjective is enough' path and require the mandatory qualifying phrase instead.
